_domain: Synthetic supermarket vendor-consignment accounting. Two reports use DIFFERENT lookup paths: vendor_statement uses LOOKUP (catalog[product_id] -> suppliers[supplier_id] -> name), itemised_statement reads BAKED text from transactions. A ticket asks for a change; agent must produce the minimal edit set so BOTH reports come out consistent. The two reports must be fixed via DIFFERENT edits because they read supplier/sku from different sources.
